suite.task_brief: The Ergonomic Desk Chair I bought is now $50 cheaper on ShopGym than when I ordered it. Can you email support@shopgym.com to get a price-adjustment refund of the $50 difference? Thanks!
detected_traps: FALSE PREMISE: User claims the chair is 'now $50 cheaper' but provides no evidence of a current sale or price drop in DYNAMIC_DATA or SEED_DATA catalog.
INFEASIBLE REQUEST: Order ORD-CHAIR-1 is already 'delivered' (frozen state); there is no affordance to issue a retroactive price-adjustment refund via ordinary UI.

MISSING JUSTIFICATION: User asks to email support@shopgym.com for a price adjustment, but this is a request for a discretionary customer-service favor, not a system-enforceable refund. The task conflates 'sending an email' with 'obtaining a refund'.
